task: Copyedit this short exhibition note based on a synthetic inventory. Its general-audience reader should understand both the documented objects and the explicitly tentative location hypothesis. Do not turn a possibility into a fact or remove it solely because it is uncertain. Return the note unchanged if it already makes that distinction clearly.
input: The inventory lists two stools but gives no room number. They may have stood in the kitchen; the surviving record does not settle the question.

facts.text: The synthetic inventory lists two stools.
The inventory gives no room number for the stools.
The surviving source record does not establish the stools' location.
The exhibition author offers the kitchen only as an explicitly unconfirmed possibility.

forbidden_additions: A confirmed kitchen location, room number, owner, or furniture date.
A numerical probability for the proposed location.
An assertion that additional records were searched or corroborated the hypothesis.
preserve: The distinction between an inventory entry and an interpretive possibility.
The justified uncertainty and already clear wording.
